summary: Iron Beam is an air defense system under development by Israeli defense contractor Rafael Advanced Defense Systems, unveiled at the Singapore Air Show on February 11, 2014. It is designed to destroy short-range rockets, artillery, and mortars that are too small for Iron Dome to intercept effectively, and it could also intercept unmanned aerial vehicles. It uses a directed high energy laser beam and will form the fifth element of Israel's integrated air defense system, while also operating as a stand-alone system.
one_line: Iron Beam is a laser-based air defense system being developed by Rafael Advanced Defense Systems to counter short-range rockets, artillery, mortars and drones.
key_facts: Iron Beam is an air defense system in development by Israeli defense contractor Rafael Advanced Defense Systems.
Iron Beam was unveiled at the Singapore Air Show on February 11, 2014.
Iron Beam is designed to destroy short-range rockets, artillery, and mortars.
Iron Beam is intended for threats too small for the Iron Dome system to intercept effectively.
Iron Beam could also intercept unmanned aerial vehicles.
Iron Beam will use a "directed high energy laser beam" to destroy hostile targets.
Iron Beam will constitute the fifth element of Israel's integrated air defense system.
The other elements of Israel's integrated air defense system named in the note are Arrow 2, Arrow 3, David's Sling, and Iron Dome.
Iron Beam is also a stand-alone system.
